messages:
Nina (CSM): flagged low-usage alert for Loopline (account: loop-42). embeddings down ~70% vs avg. noticed Sunday.
Omar (AE): thanks. any outage or client-side change?
Priya (CS): no service incidents. their integration shows fewer calls, same error rates. suspect procurement hold.
Vik (Procurement @Loopline): confirm we paused bulk indexing last week while we re-evaluate vendors. finance wants a short vendor scorecard.
Nina (CSM): ok, we need an expedited pack: 1) 1-pg vendor scorecard template, 2) token-level cost delta w/ batching and quant sims, 3) 3-sample drift eval on canonical prompts.
Omar (AE): i'll draft a competitive snapshot highlighting our fallback model and private deployment options. will include 30/60 day trial pricing.
Vik (Procurement @Loopline): competitor in play is "EdgeForge" and an internal accelerator. they care about cost and data residency.
Priya (CS): Ops Bot, can you pull last 30d 95th latency + tokens for loop-42?
Ops Bot: exported metrics: /exports/loop-42/1756668888/metrics.csv (link). includes token counts, 50/90/95 latency buckets, error rates.
Nina (CSM): thanks. target timeline: 24 hours for the initial pack. if they run a bakeoff, propose a 2-week mirrored traffic pilot with clear eval criteria.
Omar (AE): suggested pilot metrics: token cost, 95th latency, success rate on top-3 endpoints, and semantic drift score on 3 prompts.
Vik (Procurement @Loopline): that aligns. procurement also wants legal bullet points on IP and right-to-use.
Priya (CS): copying Legal checklist we use for private deployments, will DM Vik. includes KMS/HSM notes and residency options.
Nina (CSM): action items: Omar -> competitor snapshot + trial pricing (6h), Priya -> legal checklist & 3 prompt regression set (6h), Ops Bot -> attach exported perf slices to playbook (now). Vik -> share vendor scorecard template criteria.
Vik (Procurement @Loopline): will send evaluation rubric by EOD.
Omar (AE): acked. I'll also call out quick wins: batching and KV cache suggestions that could cut their token spend ~15% in pilot.
Priya (CS): i'll prepare a short runbook for the mirrored pilot and rollback steps.
Nina (CSM): great. logging this in renewal playbook under loop-42. ping here with uploads. :thumbsup:
Ops Bot: renewal playbook updated: playbooks/renewal/loop-42-1756668888 (link)
Nina (CSM): thanks team — prioritize cost vs fidelity artifacts for procurement. if they ask for exec readout, Omar will lead.
